title: Ask {helper} to help
intro: Choose a task and send a request with the price and start time that work for you.
slotUnavailable: That time was just booked or removed. You can still send a request.
slotRequestUnavailable: This request couldn't be sent. The open time may have been booked or removed. Open a regular request to choose another time.
slotTaskHint: These are your open tasks that fit this time and category.
slotStartHint: Choose a start within your task's window and before the open time ends. All times are in {zone}.
noSlotTasksTitle: No tasks fit this time yet
noSlotTasksDescription: Post a task in this opening's category and time window, then come back to request it.
noTasksDescription: You don't have an open task in this helper's categories yet. Post one, then come back to request their help.

again.label: From your booking on {date}
again.private: Only {helper} sees this request. It isn't posted for other helpers.
again.descriptionHint: As it was last time. Change anything that's different.
again.startHint: Any time from 2 hours to 14 days from now. Times are in {zone}.
again.requestOpen: You already sent {helper} this request. It's waiting in My tasks.

taskHint: These are your open tasks in {helper}'s categories.
startHint: Choose a start within the task's window. All times are in {zone}.
pricingTypeHint: Use a fixed price or an hourly rate with a limit on hours.
priceHint: Enter the task price. Your service fee is shown in the total below.
rateHint: Enter the hourly rate. The hold covers the hours cap and service fee.
estimatedHoursHint: How long you expect the task to take.
hoursCapHint: The most hours included in this request, up to 24.
messageHint: Share anything the helper should know. Keep contact details out until the booking is confirmed.
hold: We'll place a hold of {amount} on your card. You're charged only if {helper} accepts.
release: The hold is released if {helper} declines or doesn't answer before the request expires. Requests expire 48 hours after sending or 2 hours before the start, whichever is sooner.
quoteHint: Enter a valid price to see your total before sending.
quoteError: Couldn't update the total. Try again before sending your request.
terms: I agree to the <terms>Terms of service</terms> and the <cancellation>Cancellation policy</cancellation>.
sent: Request sent. You'll hear back when your helper responds.

previews.slot-not-allowed: Request Jordan — opening unavailable when sending
previews.no-tasks: Request Jordan — post a task first
previews.book-again: Book again — the desk, beside an open task
